title: Tall whites came in the last ice age to use Earth as a pit stop

tellings.quote: >> Well, they came here in the middle of the last ice age because we for the same reason that we have a base on Guam.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years living alongside tall, pale, human-like aliens he calls the tall whites at Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada, says these beings first came to Earth in the middle of the last ice age. He says they came for the same reason the US keeps a base on the Pacific island of Guam: Earth is a handy stopping point on their travels. Hall tells it as something he learned from his own time with them.
